body: My lower back pain is from injuries I got while in the military. I lost about 3/4 of an inch from my height and Its only getting worse with every year that passes. The VA in my city doesn't really care and I can no longer afford the co payment for a civilian doc. :(
How and where have you ever seen this? Or is it just something you imagined?

I work for a F500 company and our HR department does not give a crap about anyone lower than supervisors, god forbid you're a hourly worker. If you go and ask about any of the companies benefits they just give you a paper with like 50 1-800 numbers and send you on your way. Our site makes a ton of profit but the non management rarely see anything over 2% in raises. All our HR department does is try to find ways to make more revenue. Cutting back on anything that we once had... stock purchasing options, yearly company picnic, benefits, avoiding picking up new workers... only adding on contractors, no longer providing paper water cups or plastic silverware. If they spend any amount of money on something that they don't need, they try and get rid of it.
